battle_low_b.png:
A wide background painting for a cartoon game battle screen, seen straight on like a stage set.

The room: a cat village storehouse at the base of the tower - stacked rice sacks, hanging dried fish, wooden crates and a paper lantern, warm daylight from a high window

CRITICAL - THE FLOOR LINE: the boundary between the wall and the floor must sit at 56% of the image height,
measured from the top. The characters stand with their feet on that line, so if it is higher or lower they
look like they are floating. The lower 44% is floor receding towards the viewer.
Leave the middle of the picture relatively plain and uncluttered - characters stand there and must stay readable.
Push the interesting detail to the left and right thirds.
No characters, no creatures, no text, no letters, no watermark, no border, no user interface.
Style: thick outlines, flat colors with soft shading, cute cartoon look, warm and slightly worn, not photorealistic.
Output 1280x720 PNG. Save the image as battle_low_b.png in the current directory and report the path.
